# monotaur_service_account (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur service account by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_service_account" "ci_bot" {
  id = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the service account to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the service account was created.
- `description` (String) An optional description of the service account.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the service account is disabled.
- `name` (String) The name of the service account.
